body:
Establish that native PR validation executes the patched checkout. In #53 both completed AnnData suites traced an old guard to `site-packages` after the workspace source patch applied; zero exports remain unchanged. [Source/offline findings](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/fadedb0c/experiments/56-source-provenance/results.md). Subissue of #33.

A real offline synthetic pip experiment reproduced replacement of an editable version 0.0.0 when a companion requires a newer release. This demonstrates a possible mechanism, **not the exact AnnData transaction**. The pinned upstream preset recommends 0.0.0; collection success alone does not verify source identity. Eight synthetic origin cases pass, including both symlink directions, missing/namespace/import-error ambiguity and an already-imported foreign module.

The prototype reports module realpaths/hashes and distribution metadata; it is not a native grading or package-validity gate. Project/import mapping, exact Git/patch identity, native extensions/rebuilt code and same-process pytest provenance remain unresolved. A separate reporting-only pytest candidate now passes eight paired real pytest comparisons (16 processes), preserving exit codes/counts while exposing runtime-only and stale-code imports. It is not integrated into the native pipeline; any native comparison still needs a separately recorded candidate and admission.

Initial source/offline scope only: no new native/model admission, AnnData retry, install/import/test/timeout/parser/reward repair, extra LLM stage or budget allowance. Small sources/reports/failure logs are versioned; disposable owned fixture environments/scratch removed, no owned `/tmp` data. Original #53 evidence/cleanup is complete. Keep child/epic open for review; concise status here, logs in comments; no merge/release.
